target_environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (Optional, 4 GB VRAM)

supported_capabilities: CSV Flow Upload, Validation & Chunked Parsing (CP-04)
ML Training Pipeline, Resource Preflight & Model Registry (CP-06)
Model Evaluation Laboratory, ROC/PR Curves & Holdout Governance (CP-07)
Intrusion Detection Engine, Multi-Algorithm Inference & Disagreement Analysis (CP-08)
Prediction Explorer, Attribute Filtering & Analyst Review Journal (CP-09)
Threat Intelligence, STIX 2.1 ATT&CK Loader & Evidence-Aware Context (CP-10)
Publication-Grade PDF Reporting, Structured CSV Exports & Evidence Bundles (CP-11)
Local-First Architecture, Concurrency Locks & Integrity Verification (CP-12)
security_safeguards: Strict local-first runtime with zero telemetry or cloud API leakage
Strict test-fixture isolation preventing synthetic models in production
Cryptographic SHA-256 verification across all dataset, model, and report artifacts
CSV formula injection (DDE) mitigation on all spreadsheet downloads
Configurable IPv4 host address privacy redaction across reports and bundles
Path-traversal and directory escape protection on all file and archive operations
Immutable raw datasets and append-only analyst audit journals
known_limitations: Offline batch analysis: designed for flow CSV captures, not live raw packet sniffing (PCAP)
Fixed algorithm scope: restricted strictly to the 3 authorized algorithms by architectural mandate
Evaluation holdout lock: one-time test evaluation per candidate freeze to prevent data snooping
